name: A worried customer
situation: A hotel receptionist is helping a traveler who is worried their reservation was lost.
transcript:
Guest: I have been traveling all night. Please tell me I still have a room.
Receptionist: May I see your booking number?
Guest: Here. I am really worried.

name: A repeated interruption
situation: A tired colleague is interrupted for the fourth time about an answer they already sent. They remain polite but their patience is wearing thin.
transcript:
Colleague: Did you check the number?
Speaker: I sent it ten minutes ago.
Colleague: Can you check it again?
Speaker: It is in the email.
Colleague: Just check one more time.

name: A new employee is unsure
situation: A new employee has been asked an unfamiliar technical question. They want to help but are unsure where to find the answer.
transcript:
Customer: Does the adapter support that configuration?
Employee: I have not used that setup yet.
Customer: Could you confirm it before I buy it?
